name: brdcomp-card
title: Card
description: A flexible content container for grouping related information. Use header/content/footer slots or place any custom layout inside.

examples.title: Card layout
examples.code:
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card"

<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Card title</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>Card content</CardContent>
  <CardFooter>Card footer</CardFooter>
</Card>
